title: Add benchmark-lab mixed workload profiling baselines and reporting pipeline (v52)
author: Marta Huang
release_notes: Added mixed workload profiling runners (v52), profiling baselines, dashboards and a scheduled reporting pipeline. Includes CI job to publish results to GCS/BigQuery and an Airflow DAG for nightly aggregation.
commits: init: add mixed workload runner and harness
perf: add profiling baseline collection & serialization (v52)
infra: add airflow DAG and reporting job for benchmark lab
ci: add benchmark-lab reporting CI workflow
fix(lint): address flake8/typing issues from review
chore: update docs and example run configs
description:
Summary: Add mixed-workload profiling runners (v52), store profiling baselines, and create a nightly reporting pipeline that uploads aggregated results to GCS and BigQuery. This enables longitudinal tracking of latency/throughput/memory regressions across representative mixed workloads.

Motivation: We need a repeatable baseline for mixed workload scenarios to detect regressions introduced by kernel changes, batching improvements, or quantization profiles. Existing per-model single-workload baselines don't capture multi-stream behavior seen in production. The reporting pipeline centralizes results and populates dashboards for SRE and model owners.

What I changed (high level):
- Added a new mixed_workload_runner that composes user/chat/embedding traffic patterns and collects per-step traces (latency, token throughput, GPU memory snapshots).
- Added serialization for profiling baselines (benchmark-lab/profiling/baselines/v52) and a JSON schema for consumption by dashboarding.
- Added Airflow DAG (infra/airflow/dags/benchmark_reporting.py) to run nightly jobs and call a reporting service that writes to GCS and BigQuery.
- Added CI workflow (ci/workflows/benchmark-lab-reporting.yaml) to run a lightweight smoke run and publish artifacts on success.
- Tests: unit tests for the runner and an integration test that verifies reporting publish API calls are mocked.
- Docs and examples: README and example run config.

Checklist: 
- [x] New runner implemented and unit-tested
- [x] Baseline serialization format documented
- [x] Airflow DAG + CI workflow added
- [x] Dashboards/queries (not in this PR) will consume the published BigQuery tables

Commits summary: init -> add runner -> add baselines -> infra -> ci -> lint fixes -> docs. See `commits` section for titles.

Changed files (high level): see files_changed. The runner is ~600 LOC including comments; serializer is ~250 LOC; airflow DAG ~120 LOC; CI workflow YAML ~80 LOC; tests ~100 LOC combined.

Review/conversation highlights: 
- Diego: "Please add tags/labels to the reported metrics so we can filter by region/model/variant in dashboards." -> Added `tags` field to serialized baseline and updated runner to populate region/model/variant.
- Ben: "Memory snapshots look heavy, can we sample them to avoid large artifacts?" -> Implemented sampling every N steps (configurable) and compressed the stored JSON.
- Asha: "CI run failed on linting initially; please follow repo flake8/typing guidelines." -> Fixed and pushed a lint commit; CI reran and passed.

CI summary: Initial run: fail (flake8/typing). Second run: pass. Smoke tests (small runner invocation) pass; reporting publish mock validated. Full nightly runs will use production GCP creds and are gated by infra config.

Merge: After approvals from Diego and Ben and green CI, merged to main via squash. Merge commit message: 'benchmark-lab: add mixed workload profiling v52 and reporting pipeline'

Notes for operators:
- To enable nightly reporting in staging, set AIRFLOW_CONN_GCS and BIGQUERY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT in infra secrets.
- Baseline format: top-level keys: run_id, tags, metrics {latency_p50,p90,p99,throughput}, memory_samples (sampled), profile_version="v52".

Related: linked Linear tasks ENG-8921 (runner), ENG-9030 (reporting infra), PM-412 (product acceptance).
